description: Extract HTML element attribute values that Open Crawler cannot via XPath (TextNode-only limitation), then remove full_html to avoid index bloat. Requires full_html_extraction_enabled: true in the crawler config.

script.description: Regex-extract data-attribute-type from elements with class 'product-variant_list'. Adjust class name, attribute name, and target field for your site.

remove.description: Remove full_html after attribute extraction to avoid index bloat.
